Acute gastroenteritis (AGE) captures the bulk of infectious cases of diarrhea.\nThe most common manifestations are diarrhea and vomiting, which can also be associated with systemic features such as abdominal pain and fever.
Abdominal films are not indicated in the management of acute gastroenteritis.
